<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>System blocked: license grace period has ended. Please acquire a license to continue.</span></div>

## Why it happens

The system stayed over its licence limits for longer than the grace period. The system administrator can still sign in, view, delete and manage the licence.

## Fix it

Delete entities until you are under every limit, or activate a licence with higher limits. The block clears straight away.

## Check that it worked

Creating an item works again.
